briefdescription.para: Convert a VectorIndexManager distance to a cosine similarity score [0, 1].

detaileddescription.para:
distance
Input parameter.
Return value.
For the COSINE metric VectorIndexManager stores distance = 1 - cosine, so similarity = 1 - distance. Clamped to [0, 1] to guard against floating- point rounding artefacts near the boundaries. Calls: std::max(), std::min().

context
Input parameter.
Return value.
.1] Calls: empty(), std::min().
